question: What is WeIntern?
answer: WeIntern is an EdTech platform where students don't wait for opportunities — they build them. WeIntern provides industry-focused internship programs with live projects, mentor support, verified certificates, and stipend opportunities across multiple domains.

question: Does WeIntern offer internships?
answer: Yes. WeIntern offers structured internship programs in Full Stack Web Development, Mobile App Development, AI & Automation, Cloud Solutions & DevOps, UI/UX Design, Digital Marketing, and Data Science & Analytics.

question: How do I apply for an internship?
answer: To apply for a WeIntern internship: 1) Visit the official website we-intern.in. 2) Choose your preferred domain. 3) Complete the registration form. 4) Complete payment through available payment methods. 5) Receive enrollment confirmation, WhatsApp group invitation, and orientation details on your registered email and WhatsApp.

answer: Yes. WeIntern is a legitimate EdTech platform. Students can verify program details through the official website we-intern.in or contact the support team through the official communication channels.

question: Will I get a certificate from WeIntern?
answer: Yes. Certificates depend on the program you enroll in. The ₹7,999 (6-Month) plan includes an Internship Completion Certificate, a Training Certificate, and a Letter of Recommendation (LOR). The ₹999 plan includes an Internship Completion Certificate and a Letter of Recommendation (LOR). All certificates are issued under the WeIntern brand and can be added to your LinkedIn profile.
